\begin{example} \end{example}[optimality: only $C^{1,1}$ limits under lower curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0448 ↗ thm:pet-ch11-lower-sec-bound-injectivity-norm-control 1. ch11:11.4.12As $\varepsilon \to 0$, consider rotationally symmetric metrics $dr^2+\phi _\varepsilon ^2(r)d\theta ^2$ with $\phi _\varepsilon $ concave $\phi _\varepsilon (r)=r$ for $0\le r\le 1-\varepsilon $ and $\phi _\varepsilon (r)=\tfrac 34r$ for $r\ge 1+\varepsilon $, have $\sec \ge 0$, $\inj \ge 1$, and converge to a $C^{1,1}$ manifold with $C^{0,1}$ metric $(M,g)$, for which $\| (M,g)\| _{C^{1,r}}<\infty $ for all $r$: limit spaces of sequences with $\inj \ge R$, $\sec \ge -k^2$ cannot in general be smoother than this. \end{example}
